description: What the end-to-end suite must notice on the whole path from the owner's mcp-servers.json to the model's wire (lib/mcp/client-manager.mjs, lib/mcp/server-config.mjs, lib/mcp/sdk.mjs, lib/manager.mjs, lib/hooks.mjs, lib/permissions.mjs, lib/agent.mjs, lib/concurrent-api-agent.mjs), with real servers: launch approval, pins at the preflight, the server's environment, the capabilities the client declares, the secret header, the gate's destructiveHint rule, the hook alias, the lost call, the instruction cap, the child's client manager, the .cmd shim and the shutdown. A mutant that makes the gate stop asking where the suite waits for a question ends by the suite's 30 s wait; one that replays the killed call by the legacy server's 15 s call deadline.

mutations.name: L1-launch-not-checked
mutations.what: a stdio server starts without an approved launch record

mutations.name: L2-pin-not-checked
mutations.what: a connected server is usable (catalog and calls) whether or not its lists match the owner's pin

mutations.name: L3-catalog-ignores-pin
mutations.what: catalogGroups() offers every connected server, pinned or not

mutations.name: L4-preflight-does-not-relist
mutations.what: the task preflight does not list a connected server again, so a change after approval is not caught before the catalog is built

patches.old: if (connection?.state === 'connected') await this.#refreshLists(connection, { signal, timeout: connection.timeouts.connectMs });

mutations.name: L5-stale-fingerprint-pins
mutations.what: approveTools pins the lists as they are now, whatever fingerprint the owner was shown

patches.old: if (expected !== undefined && expected !== current.fingerprint) return { ok: false, reason: 'fingerprint_mismatch' };

mutations.name: E1-child-gets-the-whole-environment
mutations.what: a stdio server inherits the Hub's whole environment, OPENAI_API_KEY included

mutations.name: E2-client-declares-sampling
mutations.what: the client declares sampling, roots and elicitation, so a server may ask for the owner's model and workspace

mutations.name: E3-header-reference-not-expanded
mutations.what: a header such as "Bearer ${WEB_TOKEN}" is sent as typed, without the secret

mutations.name: E4-plain-spawn
mutations.what: stdio servers are started with child_process.spawn instead of cross-spawn, so a .cmd shim does not start on Windows

mutations.name: G1-destructive-hint-ignored
mutations.what: a tool the server marks destructiveHint: true runs under Full Access without a question

mutations.name: H2-no-aliases-in-payload
mutations.what: the hook payload does not carry tool_aliases

mutations.name: R1-lost-call-is-a-result
mutations.what: a call whose server died is handed to the model as an error result and the task goes on

mutations.name: R2-lost-call-replayed
mutations.what: a call whose server died is sent once more (on a new connection)

patches.old: return await mcp.callTool(parts.server, parts.tool, args ?? {}, { signal: options.signal, timeoutMs: options.timeout });
patches.new: return await mcp.callTool(parts.server, parts.tool, args ?? {}, { signal: options.signal, timeoutMs: options.timeout }).catch(() => mcp.callTool(parts.server, parts.tool, args ?? {}, { signal: options.signal, timeoutMs: options.timeout }));

mutations.name: C1-no-name-cap
mutations.what: the instructions name every external tool

mutations.name: C2-child-own-client
mutations.what: a spawn_agent child gets a client manager of its own (its folder configures no server)

mutations.name: S1-shutdown-leaves-servers
mutations.what: HubManager.shutdown() does not close the client manager, so the stdio servers keep running
